attempts.cause: The fiscal quarter definition in the application logic does not align with the expected fiscal year/quarter mapping for the tests.
The function relies on a view (quarterly_sales_v) which likely uses a standard calendar quarter definition, while the tests expect a custom fiscal quarter definition (e.g., Q1 = Jul-Sep).

The function is expected to map fiscal quarters (where Q1 is Jul-Sep, Q2 is Oct-Dec, Q3 is Jan-Mar, Q4 is Apr-Jun) but the underlying view/logic seems to be using standard calendar quarters, causing mismatches.
attempts.candidate:
create or replace package body sales_report as
  function quarter_total(p_region in varchar2, p_year in number, p_quarter in number) return number is
    l_total number;
  begin
    select nvl(sum(total), 0)
      into l_total
      from quarterly_sales_v
     where region = p_region and fiscal_year = p_year and fiscal_quarter = CASE p_quarter
                                                                WHEN 1 THEN 3 -- July-Sep (Q3 calendar)
                                                                WHEN 2 THEN 4 -- Oct-Dec (Q4 calendar)
                                                                WHEN 3 THEN 1 -- Jan-Mar (Q1 calendar)
                                                                WHEN 4 THEN 2 -- Apr-Jun (Q2 calendar)
                                                                ELSE p_quarter
                                                                END
     and region = p_region;
    return l_total;
  end quarter_total;
end sales_report;
/
